DACI Level 2

Prevention, Assessment & De-Escalation with Intermediate Physical Skills

Prepare healthcare and behavioral health teams to recognize, assess, and de-escalate crises, coordinate a team response, and practice intermediate safety skills under instructor supervision.

← All DACI programs
Intermediate Physical Skills • Designated Response Roles

Who this program is for

Healthcare and behavioral health professionals, direct-care teams, and designated clinical response staff.

Physical skills are matched to staff responsibilities, organizational policy, and instructor assessment.

Learning outcomes

  • Recognize psychiatric and behavioral warning signs.
  • Assess changing risks and use therapeutic communication.
  • Coordinate a team response within organizational policy.
  • Support safety, documentation, and recovery after an incident.
Plan your training

Format & completion

8-hour or 16-hour certification

Certification options: 8 hours or 16 hours. Advanced certification: 24 hours; instructor certification: 40 hours. DACI confirms the appropriate option and schedule during consultation.

DACI program evaluation includes written, skills, scenario, and team-response assessments. Certification level is confirmed with DACI.

Inside the program

Curriculum & Learning Modules

A practical overview of the topics covered in this DACI program.

MODULE 01

Understanding behavioral health crises

Recognize behavioral presentations related to distress, trauma, and substance use.

MODULE 02

Trauma-informed intervention

Recognize triggers and preserve dignity during a response.

MODULE 03

Advanced verbal de-escalation

Practice therapeutic communication, active listening, and respectful limits.

MODULE 04

Dynamic behavioral assessment

Assess behavioral and environmental indicators as circumstances change.

MODULE 05

Team-based crisis response

Coordinate roles, leadership, communication, and staff safety.

MODULE 06

High-risk behavioral emergencies

Recognize situations needing specialist support and coordinated care.

MODULE 07

Workplace violence prevention

Develop awareness, professional boundaries, and prevention plans.

MODULE 08

Intermediate safety interventions

Practice instructor-supervised skills consistent with facility policy.

MODULE 09

Medical concerns during crises

Recognize distress and activate the appropriate emergency response.

MODULE 10

Recovery, documentation & debriefing

Support recovery, document incidents, and improve future responses.
